# Station routes settings captures — PR #4244

Retention: source-pinned visual evidence for this PR; retain with its review history.
Captured from `d0cd2818f66cf0b43ce6761ce62f5b5492e60dd2` in headless Chromium on an isolated instance
(`./station start --watch --temp-home`) with the Station routes preview on and
a Tailscale route added by hand. These show UI state only, not native shell rendering.

- `settings-routes-view-dark-390.jpg`, `settings-routes-view-light-1440.jpg`:

- `settings-routes-edit-light-1440.jpg`, `settings-routes-edit-dark-390.jpg`:
